purpose: Quatro conceitos alternativos do espirito maligno para escolha do usuario. Nenhum substitui o sprite ativo.

variants.label: Chama jade
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: alternative evil-spirit enemy sprite concept for the existing Unity fantasy RPG.
Input image: reference image ONLY for its polished retro JRPG pixel-art rendering, pixel clusters, outline weight, shading density, and three-quarter battle view. Do NOT copy the king, crown, clothing, weapon, or human anatomy.
Create exactly ONE isolated full-body floating evil spirit, one idle pose, three-quarter view facing RIGHT. This is a new character design for choosing a replacement, not a sprite sheet. Match the supplied game's detailed pixel sprites: crisp stepped pixel contours, readable chunky pixel clusters, selective dark outline, restrained 5–7 shade ramps, no smooth vector shapes, no photorealism or 3D render. A sinister supernatural possessor suitable as a castle boss, expressive and readable at small game size.
Composition: square canvas, entire spirit centered with generous genuinely transparent padding on every side. Fit every tendril inside frame. About 78 percent canvas height. No scenery, ground, drop shadow, UI, text, numbers, labels, watermark, extra characters, or grid. Preserve actual alpha transparency. One coherent silhouette; no large detached magic effect.
Subject and palette: A lean teardrop-shaped living spectral flame, asymmetrical flickering crest, a small bone-white narrow skull face set within the green fire, two small floating clawlike hands joined by wisps, body tapering into one strongly curled comma-shaped smoke tail. No hood, robe, legs, crown, horns, or armor. The silhouette should feel like a crooked candle flame. Palette: deep petrol outlines, emerald green body, luminous mint and pale yellow-green inner fire, small ivory face, bright cream eyes. Keep a severe eerie expression, not a cute slime.
